title: Doob-Based Generative Policy Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.28990v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion and flow models provide expressive policy classes for robotic and sequential decision-making systems. However, their action likelihoods are generally intractable, limiting the direct use of widely adopted policy optimization methods such as PPO and GRPO. We propose Doob Policy Optimization (DoobPO), a framework that leverages Doob's $h$-transform for likelihood-free reinforcement learning fine-tuning of generative policies. DoobPO separates policy improvement from generative policy learning. It first learns a lightweight ratio model that represents the desired policy update, and then distills the resulting ratio-tilted target policy into the generative policy via conditional drift matching. This formulation applies uniformly to both diffusion and flow policies and supports a broad family of policy improvement rules, including PPO and GRPO. translated_title: 基于 Doob 的生成式策略优化
translated_abstract: 扩散模型和流模型为机器人与序列决策系统提供了表达能力强的策略类别。然而，它们的动作似然通常难以计算，这限制了直接使用诸如 PPO 和 GRPO 等被广泛采用的策略优化方法。我们提出了 Doob 策略优化（DoobPO），这是一个利用 Doob 的 h 变换对生成式策略进行无似然强化学习微调的框架。DoobPO 将策略改进与生成式策略学习相分离：它首先学习一个轻量级的比率模型来表示期望的策略更新，然后通过条件漂移匹配将由此得到的比率倾斜目标策略蒸馏进生成式策略中。这一构建方式统一适用于扩散策略和流策略，并支持广泛的策略改进规则族，包括 PPO 和 GRPO。我们证明了实际使用的条件漂移匹配目标在梯度上是等价的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 DoobPO 框架，利用 Doob 的 h 变换通过比率模型与条件漂移匹配，实现无需似然计算的扩散与流生成式策略强化学习微调，并统一兼容 PPO、GRPO 等策略改进规则。
en_tdlr: DoobPO leverages Doob's h-transform with a lightweight ratio model and conditional drift matching to enable likelihood-free RL fine-tuning of diffusion and flow generative policies, uniformly supporting policy improvement rules such as PPO and GRPO.
